from collections import Counter
out=[]
for i in range(9):
 row=[]
 for j in range(9):
  vals=A[i*3:i*3+3,j*3:j*3+3].flatten()
  c=Counter(x for x in vals if x!=5)
  row.append(c.most_common())
 out.append(row)
print([[x[0][0] if x else 5 for x in row] for row in out])
print(out)
